decision: REJECTED for deployment. Preserves all17 baseline-found large objects and finds26/35 vs25/35, but old-task obstacle IoU falls0.27155→0.24659 and ground-as-obstacle rises0.16072→0.20122. Five-class small-rock labels also confuse many old substantial-obstacle pixels with class4. Keep v11.

baseline_original_controls.limitations: Sparse visual labels on a few separate PDS episodes; not independent expert truth, exhaustive full-image precision, flight qualification, or proof of zero misses. Physical route blockage additionally needs measured stereo size/relief.

candidate_original_controls.limitations: Sparse visual labels on a few separate PDS episodes; not independent expert truth, exhaustive full-image precision, flight qualification, or proof of zero misses. Physical route blockage additionally needs measured stereo size/relief.

appearance_validation.limitations: Strict sparse appearance labels only: untraced old ground is a composite0-or4 and excluded here. Not exhaustive foreground precision, independent expert labels, new unseen benchmark or physical traversability.

appearance_consumed_controls.limitations: Strict sparse appearance labels only: untraced old ground is a composite0-or4 and excluded here. Not exhaustive foreground precision, independent expert labels, new unseen benchmark or physical traversability.

compatibility_export.compatibility: logsumexp ground0+additional_rock4; original obstacle1/hardware2/sky3 preserved as channels

next_research: Keep appearance (all rocks) and measured traversability separate. Consider a size-agnostic auxiliary rock head with the old navigation output frozen, plus more reviewed negative ground and complete object outlines; validate on a new sealed episode set before promotion. Do not train another candidate against the consumed controls and call them a fresh test.
